memory.reason: Keeping the iron down creates two Church records that disagree by ten days about when the child began. That is a concrete pedigree/record contradiction with a natural later reader, distinct from the immediate rumour and cost.

The public-warrant outcome explicitly says licensed practice becomes the cheapest cover the house has ever been offered. Preserve the flag for the later standing/visitor/magic-cover consequence that authored prose promises.

Sending the Life book to Bramme creates an external institutional touchpoint and returns a correct marginal correction in an unknown hand. Preserve the marker for a later chapter-house/library callback rather than treating the copy as purely private.

The survey outcome explicitly says the clerk's clause is not read for nine years and then is read when war comes. Preserve the flag for that authored war/survey callback instead of deleting the promised future consequence.

The held inquest outcome explicitly sends the ledger away with the Church. That is durable external evidence with a natural later inquest/record reader, and the branch otherwise has no lasting effect.
Defying either widening explicitly makes the Church permanently hostile, a state the Great Rite design says the house carries into later ascension.

The successful correction outcome explicitly promises that the filed correction becomes 'exactly the right nine days' when it later matters. A future institutional reader must pay off that authored promise.
The refusal is the second Church refusal in a century and explicitly makes the Church begin to find the house interesting.
ending.ts already reads GOD_RITE_FAILED even though the content-only audit cannot see it; deleting this would break The Unmade ending.
The outcome explicitly says a Warden will later use the legal word for what the house did. Reserve this flag for that later institutional consequence rather than deleting an authored payoff promise.
The quiet branch intentionally hides an early waking; a later callback should distinguish concealment from the publicly marked branch so this secrecy has a durable non-money consequence.

Letting the village story run is intentionally an expressive choice: the event-level rumour already carries the story and the outcome needs no invented resource cost. Delete the dead flag and tag let_it_run as self_expression in the later content slice.

Buying the looted library costs 220 crowns and explicitly promises that three volumes enable the house's great-grandchildren. Preserve the flag for the later library/book consequence needed to make that authored long-term promise real.

The Rimefell bride outcome creates a permanent descent liability: she is married in with no supporting paper and the prose explicitly says the heralds are coming. Preserve this as the natural later herald/pedigree reader rather than deleting the only durable marker of that choice.

The close-the-book outcome explicitly says the house says the Quieting at Bramme every year for 211 years without exception. Preserve the flag for the long-lived Church/chapel rule the prose promises.

Paying Bramme rates explicitly removes the parish trade and says the full arithmetic takes two generations to become visible. Preserve the flag for the later local-cost/trade consequence that makes that promise real.

Letting Caster's unsolicited loyalty list stand is a durable political choice and the outcome says the list is copied until consent is forgotten. Reserve the flag for a later institutional consequence that distinguishes being counted.

This flag is the only durable distinction between opening to Wick and being spared versus opening and the hall taking the fever; reserve it for a later household/village reader so the weighted outcome remains meaningfully distinct.

Opening the sickroom creates a witnessed dull-iron incident, a Wick rumour, and eleven years of the physician's silence. Preserve the flag for a later physician/rumour callback that distinguishes this specific exposure.

The paid-whole outcome explicitly promises that Bracc offers this house a quarter-point better rate for the next 140 years. Preserve the flag for the later trade/credit reader needed to make that authored long-term consequence real.
Conceding the Seal creates a two-century succession/regalia condition distinct from merely starting the given-seal arc.

The registrar accepts and leaves with a newly made copy of selected house-book material. That creates durable evidence outside the house and is a natural later Church/record reader, distinct from the local Respect cost.
The losing shelter outcome explicitly leaves the house named in a Cawdry file for two generations. Reserve the flag for a later institutional callback that makes that durable record matter.
The midwife notices dulling iron in the birthing room, a concrete early blood-sign clue with a natural later reader.

The leaving steward takes eleven years of knowledge about which rooms are never opened. That is a concrete former-insider exposure risk and a natural later household/secret callback, not merely flavour.
Losing the Head in the Seal challenge creates a distinct succession crisis on top of the given-seal arc.
Leaving the grandmother alone makes the four Chronicle lines the only surviving account of 1131 forever.

The refused Bramme archivist still controls the index that makes records findable and has learned exactly what this house will not pay for. That is a direct later discrepancy/exposure hook, so preserve the marker for a reader.
The outcome explicitly says the next Head inherits and reopens the argument in a bad year.

Going over Bramme's forty households creates a dated grievance held by the town's Assembly delegates, and the prose explicitly says a dated grievance lasts about four times as long. Preserve it for a later town/Assembly callback.

This key comes from #341 ranked event something_the_church_wants_more. The decline branch otherwise carries only this memory, and a later Church callback can make refusing the chantry a durable non-money consequence rather than collapsing the choice into prose.

Keeping the anomalous chapel shut is a durable institutional/myth-layer choice. A later Church or house callback should distinguish the family that concealed it rather than letting the flag remain dead.
Church sanction is durable institutional permission for the Great Rite and the intended political opposite of defiance.

This key comes from #341 ranked event what_he_did_with_the_key. The clerk asking again after receiving the short list is a natural later records/Crown callback and gives #341 a remembered institutional consequence without adding another money price.

Signing the customary terms starts a long argument about what the house agreed to 'for ever'. Preserve the flag for a later tenancy/title callback that distinguishes the written custom from the refusal branch.
The herald's shorthand becomes a standing question in a book read every third year for centuries. Preserve the flag for the later heraldic/descent consequence explicitly promised by the outcome.

The post-fever hall count is a strong cross-generation human-scale callback: a later household/feast scene can contrast a full or changed hall with the six cold grates, preserving the loss rather than leaving this automatic memory dead.
The harmless water outcome explicitly says the house learns a wrong lesson it will act on again in about forty years. Preserve the flag for that promised later well/household callback.

Winning the Wardenship is a durable institutional fact that the event itself says permanently exposes the house to Crown, Assembly, Church, and provincial attention. Keep one callback discriminator for later Warden-era consequences.

Leaving the lent book alone explicitly promises that roughly ninety years later someone will find it and write to Cawdry in a worse year. Preserve the flag for that concrete future book/Cawdry callback.

Letting the matter close otherwise has no lasting effect, and the outcome explicitly promises a 1290 discovery of a Sarrow letter addressed to the house. Preserve the flag for that concrete later letter/record callback.
The outcome explicitly promises that somebody repeats the standing insult at exactly the wrong assize thirty years later. Preserve the flag for that authored future callback.

The rare counter-offer success is the first opening in a 110-year sequence of impossible Match letters and the house talks about it for a decade. Preserve it for the natural next Match/courtship callback rather than making the 20% branch consequence-free.
The mythic burning changes the world's book economy for four hundred years; preserve the world-state marker for later library consequences.

Backing the physician leaves a paid outsider as one of only two people who knows what the third jug did. Preserve that concrete exposure fact for a later physician/house-secret callback rather than reducing the branch to relationship arithmetic.
Burning the dead man's papers destroys unique evidence unread; preserve that deliberate loss for later family-record content.
Standing ground explicitly promises that another Church office asks for the day book nineteen years later.

The hidden Death and Darkness books are moved to a specific damp second cellar and degraded there. Preserve the location marker for a later Church/library discovery rather than losing the physical secret the choice creates.

The outcome explicitly creates two divergent documents: a short copy at Cawdry and the original still open in the house. Preserve the flag for the later discrepancy/records callback that physical contradiction supports.

The short relief return explicitly says the next relief, about thirty years later, will be assessed against this number by someone with both books open. Preserve the flag for that concrete future assessment callback.

Bricking the cellar stair changes the house physically, and the outcome explicitly says somebody unbricks it in 1330. Preserve the flag for that later house/mystery callback rather than losing the only durable marker of the wall.

Refusing a successor is explicitly promised to cost four years and about ninety crowns when the steward dies. Preserve the flag for that authored succession/household callback so the future cost can become real.
The ninth-question hesitation explicitly makes the visitation return in four years instead of eleven.
Leaving the last witness to the parish puts her final statements in a curate's written record outside the house. Preserve this as durable external evidence for a later discrepancy/Church reader.

The unanswered descent question is explicitly entered in Yssene's own house record and leaves their reckoning at five generations. Preserve it for the later external-record/descent callback that this outcome creates.
Sending her to the steward explicitly promises that her children learn to read and that one decides a Cawdry boundary case in 1247. Preserve the flag for that concrete future legal callback.
Taking the Warden's deer creates an unresolved boundary/legal breach and a rumour with a natural later assize reader.

The successful wait outcome otherwise has no lasting effect and explicitly says the marriage terms improve twice before year end. Preserve the flag for the follow-up match consequence rather than turning the 55% success branch into prose only.
Patching is explicitly temporary and lasts only until the north wind returns. Preserve the flag for a later roof recurrence that distinguishes another patch from the eighty-year slate repair.

Doing the roof properly explicitly makes the west wing dry for eighty years. Preserve the flag for later hall/upkeep logic so the expensive repair actually suppresses or changes future roof consequences.
The wrong Thermal volume teaches a concrete magic/library rule and leaves uniquely useful notes even after the book is burned or sold.

The maid identifies a specific cold between the fourth and fifth step and has now told the Head. Preserve that concrete house-sign discovery for a later passage/sign investigation rather than collapsing it into relationship alone.

A recorded waking at nine directly concerns the blood and the setting's magic rules. Reserve it for a later generational callback so the family's knowledge of an unusually early waking changes how a later sign is interpreted.
Three failed nights establish a core magic rule: expression cannot be summoned on a schedule.
The grandmother's refusal reveals a specific unresolved 1131 secret and an earlier generation's imposed silence.
The literate cottager changes how eleven Wick households understand the posted terms, a durable tenant/legal fact.
A Braccish-looking stranger paid for information about this family and then stopped asking; preserve the unresolved external inquiry.
The complete copy becomes an irreversible Cawdry record for eight hundred years and is the truthful counterpart to the short-copy discrepancy.
The broker's sheets contain thirty years of marriages, grandmothers, and signs, with another copy at Cawdry; preserve this rare evidence corpus.
The byname determines what the man is called centuries later while songs and heraldic ordinals diverge.

The Crusade scene explicitly establishes a myth-layer magic-rule fact: an altar stone older than the chapel that the house did not set there. Reserve it for a later cross-generation reader that narrows this mystery rather than deleting the memory.
The Church's disguised refusal is a distinct institutional answer to a Great Rite request, separate from sanction and defiance.

This weighted outcome establishes the Marrow Codex left the province in a crate and has not been seen since. The location/fate of a named spellbook is durable world state with a natural later library/rival/recovery reader.
The comet tally is the only Nethering record and explicitly gets bought by a Corran man in 1288.
The shepherd supplies four years of precise dates about dogs refusing one piece of ground with no explanation.
The successful price call explicitly establishes an eleven-year information relationship with the drover.
Moving the expresser proves the dulling iron follows the man rather than the room; the Record tells future heads to remember it.
The inventory leaves one unexplained wrapping missing with no record of what it held, a concrete physical mystery.
The preserved fourth verse names a place and year nobody can identify and survives after the sung verse disappears.
The keeper pointedly walks under the birthing-room iron without asking, and the prose calls that omission the part worth noticing.
The keeper admits he has said the fourth petition four thousand times without knowing what it means and asks that it not reach Bramme.

Recording that the ninth petition was answered by nobody in the chapel creates a specific supernatural fact in the family's Chronicle, with Church witnesses and a total discrepancy. That is a natural later liturgy/blood reader, not generic Record boilerplate.

The rare-books outcome identifies an Old Ambric heading from an older, unnamed register and the advocate refuses to identify it. That is a concrete unresolved library fact with a natural later research/Church reader, not redundant bookkeeping.

The found quire contains four generations of a genealogy that contradicts the heralds while matching the male line exactly. That is a major lineage mystery with an obvious later descent/library reader and should not be deleted as dead bookkeeping.
The child brings the wrong-order Quiet Names rhyme from Wick, linking village folklore directly to the house's liturgy mysteries.

This weighted outcome discovers a parish entry saying the supposed Rimefell ancestress never left and died there, directly contradicting the house's descent. That is a concrete lineage-record fact with a natural later herald/record payoff, not redundant bookkeeping.
Opening the repeatedly bricked cellar reveals a bench, cut drain, and four man-height iron rings, a concrete hidden-house discovery.
Showing all three regalia creates the oldest independent surviving minute of the objects, durable external evidence.

The quiet-search outcome says the house conducts its affairs for four years without the instrument its standing rests on and only two people know it. That is a concrete ongoing secret with a natural regalia/succession reader, not redundant Record bookkeeping.

The chapel floor reveals an older stone bearing a name absent from every roll and descent, a concrete lineage mystery.
The daughter produces blood signs while examination finds no expression, leaving contradictory evidence in the press for two centuries.
Buying all three broker readings creates direct proof that common sign theories contradict one another.
The uncut Yssene silk remains through 1500 as the house's oldest object with no written origin.
The licensed beggar proves a house story travelled forty miles to Coln through Wayfolk song.
Proceeding after the answered ninth establishes that an older tenth petition exists and produces no second answer.
